content: Handlers can approve goodwill payments up to £250 from the GDR.
Beacon status Q7 means the claim is awaiting a surveyor or engineer report.
At Calderwood, TPA means Total Payout Authority: the maximum a handler can pay on a claim without referring it up. It does not mean Third Party Administrator here.
At Calderwood, LAE means Large Account Escalation: an escalation raised for a PCL customer, which goes to the Key Accounts Desk. It does not mean Loss Adjustment Expense here.
KAD is the Key Accounts Desk. It handles escalations for PCL customers.
PCL customers must get a response within 2 working hours.
PCR stands for Payments Control Review, the team that gives second approval on blocked payments.
At Calderwood, CAT means Claims Audit Trail: the log in Beacon of every action taken on a claim. It does not mean catastrophe here.
Error RFN-110 means the Ringfence found a potential sanctions match. The payment is frozen and must be referred to the Financial Crime team. Do not tell the customer the reason.
A Grade 1 handler's TPA is £2,500.
A Desk Lead can approve goodwill payments up to £1,000.
FNOL must be logged in Beacon within 4 working hours of first contact.
Error ATL-031 means Atlas can't find the policy. It's usually a migrated Keystone policy: search again with the K- prefix.
LLU is the Large Loss Unit. It handles any claim over £50,000.
RVF stands for Rapid Vulnerability Flag. Handlers set it in Beacon when a customer shows signs of vulnerability, and it routes the case to the Care Team.
Atlas is Calderwood's policy administration system, where policies and mid-term changes are managed.
At Calderwood, PML means Policy Mid-term Lapse: cover that has lapsed mid-term because a premium was missed. It does not mean Probable Maximum Loss here.
Green Lane is Calderwood's fast track for simple claims under £1,500 with no injury. Green Lane claims are auto-approved.
Motor total losses must be settled within 10 working days of the salvage category decision.
The Ringfence is Calderwood's sanctions screening tool. Every new payee must be screened in the Ringfence before a payment is made in Tally.
Beacon is Calderwood's claims management system. Every claim, including FNOL, is logged in Beacon.
Claims Audit Trail (CAT) exports are requested from Data Governance with a DG-REQ form. Never email a CAT export directly.
Error TLY-409 means Tally blocked a possible duplicate payment. It needs second approval from Payments Control Review (PCR).
A Senior handler's TPA is £50,000. Anything above that goes to the LLU.
An IBNR must be raised within 48 hours of the mid-term change.
GDR stands for Goodwill Discretion Reserve, the budget that goodwill payments to customers come out of.
Beacon status Q12 means the payment has been released.
At Calderwood, IBNR means Internal Broker Notification Request: raised in Atlas to tell a broker about a mid-term change to a policy they placed. It does not mean Incurred But Not Reported here.
Error BCN-502 means the claim is locked by another handler in Beacon. Ask your Desk Lead to release it with a Lock Release form.
An Amber Pack must reach the CFU within 2 working days of the handler spotting fraud indicators.
Customers with an RVF must get a phone call from the Care Team within 1 working day. Letters alone are not enough.
Drop is Calderwood's secure upload portal for customers to send documents and large files.
Error BCN-217 means Beacon rejected an attachment over 25MB. Split the file, or ask the customer to upload it through Drop.
CFU is the Counter Fraud Unit, the Calderwood team that investigates suspected fraudulent claims.
HSR stands for Hold for Surveyor Review. A claim on HSR is paused until the surveyor's report is back.
The Harbour scheme is Calderwood's affinity scheme for customers who buy through partner banks.
Beacon status Q3 means the claim is awaiting documents from the customer.
Escape of water claims over £15,000 must be put on HSR for a surveyor before settlement.
A Grade 2 handler's TPA is £10,000.
Tally is Calderwood's payments system. Claim payments are issued through Tally.
An Amber Pack is Calderwood's fraud referral pack. Handlers complete it and send it to the CFU when they spot fraud indicators.
Beacon status Q9 means the claim has been referred to the CFU. Q9 is internal only: never disclose it to the customer; tell them the claim is under review.
PCL stands for Premier Commercial Lines, Calderwood's top commercial customer tier.
BLT stands for Broker Liaison Team. All queries on broker-placed policies go to the BLT.
Goodwill payments above £1,000 need approval from the HCO (Head of Customer Outcomes).
Keystone is Calderwood's legacy policy system, decommissioned in 2023. Policies migrated from Keystone carry a K- prefix in Atlas.
HCO stands for Head of Customer Outcomes.
A PML policy can be reinstated with no gap in cover if the customer pays the missed premium within 14 days.
